title: Figures 10-12: Super Marx generator section renderings, proton beam injection and elements
description: Two gray artist renderings: 'Figure 10. Detailed View of a Section of the Super Marx Generator' showing coaxial capacitors over 'Marx Banks in Oil Tanks with High Voltage Capacitors' in a grounded vacuum vessel, and 'Figure 11. Injection of GeV - 10 MA Proton Beam' showing a proton beam entering a target chamber with a deuterium target. Below, line diagram 'Figure 12. Showing a Few Elements of the Super Marx Generator' depicts capacitors C, switches S and magnetic field B arrows.
